name: Fetch to cURL Converter
summary: Convert fetch() calls into equivalent curl commands.
description: Paste a JavaScript fetch(url, options) snippet and get a curl one-liner with method, headers, and body mapped automatically.

faqs.question: How are options parsed?
faqs.answer: The options object is evaluated locally in your browser — use plain object literals, not variables.

faqs.question: Production ready?
faqs.answer: Treat output as a starting point; review auth headers and complex bodies before sharing.
